caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate dress in a muted yellow or beige tone. The dress features a fitted bodice with a high neckline trimmed in white lace, and elbow-length sleeves ending in small lace cuffs. The skirt is full, gathered, and draped to the side with prominent ruching. Yellow and dark pink roses, accompanied by green leaves, decorate the right side of the bodice, the sleeve cuff, and cascade down the side and lower front of the skirt. The hem of the skirt is trimmed with a wide ruffle. The dress is drawn against a plain, light background, and there is no visible mannequin or person; the neck opening is empty. A light pencil signature reading "Carrie Forman" appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Dress
